text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm so totally sleepy it's marvelo~us... 
Truth is, Mayano and I stayed up super 
late playing...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
When I was stargazing, there were three 
UFOs parked right next to the Autumn 
Leaves constellation... And then, they 
started orbiting the Bubblegum 
constellation... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Don't worry~. And then, the UFO 
started spinning around... and around and 
around, and melted into space soup.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And then, from inside the soup, this 
completely silver, shiny kid came out... 
and we held hands with Mayano and floated 
up...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"...We're all friends, and it's so 
marvelo~us...☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway, it seems Marvelous Sunday is 
sleep-deprived."
